retrievalProfile.description: A dynamic grid of individual character portraits in red varsity attire surrounding a central, multi-layered typographic lockup with tilted angles.

recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, high-energy composition featuring a central cluster of bold, tilted text surrounded by a loose grid of square-cropped character portraits. The color palette is dominated by vibrant red, crisp white, and deep black, evoking a collegiate or varsity sports theme.
coreVisualRelationships: Central typography acts as the gravity for the surrounding portrait grid
Repetition of red varsity jackets creates visual unity across diverse subjects
Tilted text blocks create a sense of youthful energy and movement
High-key lighting on subjects against white backgrounds ensures maximum legibility
coreInvariants: Vibrant red as the primary thematic color
Tilted baseline for the main title text
White background for all portrait segments

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Ensemble cast members are distributed in a radial grid around the center; the central title occupies 40% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, black sans-serif title text in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central bold text, then moves clockwise through the character portraits, ending on the handwritten script at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White space between portrait frames creates a 'scrapbook' or 'polaroid' collage effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright Red (Varsity/Athletic Red) used in clothing and text banners.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid Black used for primary display typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp White used for backgrounds and secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value for a clean, commercial, and energetic look.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to Red, Black, and White for graphic elements

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses heavy, blocky sans-serif with tight kerning
Secondary banners use rectangular fills with knocked-out text
Bottom-most text uses a dry-brush or marker-style script
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are sheared or rotated to follow a 5-10 degree tilted baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric sans-serif for authority paired with casual marker script for a 'behind-the-scenes' or 'student' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blocky, high-impact feel of the main title
Approximates the casual, handwritten look of the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a collage of 7-8 individual portraits of young adults in red and white varsity jackets, each in a slightly tilted square frame against a white background, leaving a large white diamond-shaped space in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a central stack of bold black sans-serif text tilted at a -5 degree angle. Below it, add two horizontal banners (one red, one black) with white text. At the very bottom, add a red marker-style script on a white tape-like texture.

verificationChecks: Are the portraits wearing red varsity-style clothing?
Is there a mix of bold sans-serif and casual script?

adjustableVariables: Specific red hue (e.g., crimson vs. scarlet)
Texture of the bottom script (marker vs. paint)

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on graphic elements

postGenerationChecks: Check that no text is perfectly horizontal
Ensure the red color is consistent across all elements
Verify the 'collage' feel with distinct frame borders
Confirm the hierarchy places the black text as the primary focus
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble Grid + Tilted Bold Sans + Marker Script Accent + Varsity Red Palette
